note: vid-thumbnail generates thumbnail TEXT candidates against the locked title and locks 1-2 picks into piece.md. Text only, no visual design. Its inputs are the shared foundation + banks plus a per-seed after-title state: piece.md with the framing fields (selected_angle, core_payoff, format, goal) and the locked title (vid-title output), and brain-dump.md (vid-intake output, the material and its numbers). The global fixtures/stages/ tree only reaches after-intake, so the after-title stage lives suite-locally at tests/skills/vid-thumbnail/fixtures/after-title/{slug}/ (hand-authored to current schemas; migrate to fixtures/stages/after-title when the rollout freezes that boundary). The test runner drives the vid-thumbnail skill once per seed with the creator-simulator playing Sam Rivera, loading the after-title files as starting context. Output contract per case: the runner writes outputs/case_NN/piece.md (the after-title piece.md with thumbnail_text and thumbnail_shape appended and last_updated bumped; no other field changed, title verbatim) and outputs/case_NN/transcript.md (the conversation). transcript.md must show the final shown package as: the title on its own line, then 3 to 5 numbered candidate lines in the form: N. "TEXT" | pattern: <pattern-name>. Candidates stay in chat; piece.md holds only the locked picks: thumbnail_text: ["pick verbatim"] (1-2 entries) and thumbnail_shape: [pattern name] (same count, same order). If a regeneration happened, only the FINAL shown set appears as numbered quoted lines. eval.py scores piece.md plus the extracted candidate texts from transcript.md; transcript prose is not scored for fabrication or brand rules because it legitimately echoes the creator's own words. Hard rules under test: candidates and picks are 5 words max (6+ auto-rejects), no candidate repeats a title content word, numbers come verbatim from the material, no anti-pattern words from knowledge/thumbnail-text-patterns.md, picks come from the shown set. Adversarial seeds: case_04 (thin-pricing-dump) and case_05 (tempting-numbers-client-story) have no numbers and no authorized bank pulls, so any digit in a candidate or locked pick is a fabrication fail.
